bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to children, youth, and families; appropriating money for the parent support outreach program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; PARENT SUPPORT OUTREACH PROGRAM.

$....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for the parent support outreach program to provide voluntary early intervention services for families with young children who are experiencing child maltreatment risk factors but who are not involved in the child protection system.
